records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Product revenue accounted for 50% of our consolidated revenue for each of the three and nine months ended September 30, 2023, as compared to 52% and 48% for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The Company’s continued execution delivered strong results during the third quarter of 2023, driven by the demand for our memory interface chips and our Silicon IP solutions, and continued stability from our royalties revenue.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Changes in operating assets and liabilities for the nine months ended September 30, 2023 primarily included a decrease in unbilled receivables and increase in income taxes payable, offset by increases in income taxes receivable, inventories and accounts receivable, as well as decreases in accounts payable, accrued salaries and benefits and deferred revenue.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cost of product revenue decreased approximately $2.6 million for the three months ended September 30, 2023 as compared to the same period in 2022, primarily due to lower product revenue and a change in product mix.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cash provided by operating activities of $140.9 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2023, was primarily attributable to the cash generated from customer licensing, product sales and engineering services fees.
